Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging.™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses.

Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement.

From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News & World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

Join Collibra's Sales team as a Senior Enterprise Account Executive II, Enterprise - East Coast
Make an impact at Collibra by fueling Collibra's growth in your assigned East Coast territory and be the guiding force behind bringing Collibra's value and vision to customers and prospects. As part of our Enterprise Sales team, you will manage some of Collibra's largest customers and prospects across the East Coast region.

In this role, you will use your knowledge in Enterprise SaaS sales to establish trusted and credible relationships, build Collibra's brand and awareness around our solution, and serve as a Data Intelligence advisor throughout the customer journey, driving demand, adoption, and expansion for Collibra solutions within your territory.
Senior Enterprise Account Executives at Collibra are responsible for:
Prospecting for net new accounts, greenfield building, and developing relationships with existing customers to maintain active deal pipeline and ideal quota coverage in your East Coast territory
Managing and creating demand for expansion on existing customers to widen the footprint of Collibra within these accounts
Managing complex deal cycles, from lead origination to stakeholder mapping, through negotiation to close and expansion
Successfully collaborating with customers, partners, and peers in a consultative sales process where you will identify value and ROI to support customer's needs
Reliable, accurate forecasting, with Salesforce updates reflective of real-time activity
You have
Consistently achieved or overachieved your SaaS sales quota

s.h: Experience in the Data Management domain highly preferred
s.t:
6+ years in new business and account management SaaS/tech sales
Originated and navigated complex, direct sales cycles with multiple technical and business stakeholders
Sold net-new business and expansion opportunities to C-level buyers in large enterprise accounts
Managed consultative sales processes, with value-based impacts or outcomes
At least 2-3 years of experience in data management sales familiar with corresponding sales methodologies and comprehensible track records
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
You are
Known for your integrity and commitment to the customer
Composed, resourceful, and focused in high-growth environments
Comfortable traveling when required
Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented
A precise communicator and persuasive negotiator
Proud of your work and aim for excellence
Flexible to travel as required
Measures of success
Within your first month, you have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers
Within your third month, you will be in the midst of building a pipeline of business in your assigned East Coast territory
Within your sixth month, you will have a solid foundation of prospective clients who you will be close to closing

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.
In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

As part of our accelerating APJ growth, Databricks is looking for a dynamic Emerging Enterprise Startup Core Account Executive for GCR to join our rapidly growing team. This is an exciting Sales role that will make an important impact on the revenue and expansion of our business in Greater China. The role is based in Singapore.
Reporting to the Director, Enterprise at Databricks, you come with relevant experience selling to Startups/Commercial/Mid-Market accounts. As a successful candidate, you are a self-starter who understands the sales process.

Passionate about solving business challenges, you excel at initiating and advancing conversations to value delivery using a defined methodology.

Skilled at selling innovation, you guide deals to accelerate decision-making, articulate product value to customers and partners, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to grow existing accounts in the Greater China market.

Assess your accounts and develop a strategy to identify and engage all buying centers
Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for existing accounts
Be comfortable switching between technical stakeholder and business buyer personas, in order to connect the customers challenges to business value through the entire sales cycle
Identify and close quick wins while managing longer, complex sales cycles
Track all customer details including projects, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce
Map the whitespace opportunity across your defined territory, and use methodology to identify the most viable use cases in each account to maximise Databricks impact
Orchestrate and work with teams to maximise the impact on your ecosystem
Build value with all engagements to promote successful negotiations to close point
Be customer-focused by delivering technical and business results using the Databricks Intelligence Platform

2-3 years of Startup/ Emerging Enterprise Sales experience exceeding quotas, covering Greater China accounts or territory
Experience in working in a consumption-based sales motion
Strong closing experience and evidence of exceeding sales quota
Ability to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organization
Sales experience within Cloud software, open source technology, or ideally Data and AI space
Experience driving successful adoption of usage-based subscription services (SaaS) and co-selling with AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams
Methods for co-developing business cases and gaining support from C-level Executives
Familiarity with sales methodologies and processes (e.g. Territory and Account planning, MEDDPICC, and value/discovery selling)
Simply articulate intricate cloud technologies

Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

GitLab's APJ Ecosystem team builds and scales the partner (channel, alliance, and hyperscaler) motion across the region. ASEAN is a strategic market for GitLab, and this hire is central to strengthening our partner ecosystem there — deepening a smaller number of high-value partnerships rather than spreading thin across many transactional ones.

Based in Singapore, our Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM)- ASEAN, is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab's partner business in ASEAN countries across the full breadth of the ecosystem: hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric system integrators (SIs), and born-in-the-cloud / AI-native partners.

We are looking for someone with the range and seniority to credibly own strategic partner relationships across all of these partner types, and to help grow our business through these partners.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in ASEAN, someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with ASEAN's major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

Build and scale GitLab's partner-sourced and influence business in ASEAN across hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI partners.
Develop deep, strategic (not transactional) relationships with a focused set of priority partners — joint business plans, QBRs, and named executive sponsorship.
Own hyperscaler relationship management and Marketplace motion with AWS and/OR GCP.
Build and grow relationships with major ASEAN SIs and market-making channel/born-in-the-cloud partners and emerging AI-native partners.
Drive partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, and carry a quota tied to partner-sourced/generated revenue.
Partner closely with the ASEAN sales team to ensure partner-sourced opportunities are properly identified, supported, and closed.
Work with the ASEAN and APJ Ecosystem team to help shape and refine the ASEAN Ecosystem coverage model.
Contribute to partner enablement, certification, and go-to-market programs suited to the ASEAN market.
Report on partner engagement health, pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.

15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.
Extensive, well-rounded experience scaling a business through partners across hyperscalers, large ASEAN-centric SIs, and born-in-the-cloud/AI-native partners — not narrowly specialized in just one partner type.
Direct experience managing hyperscaler relationships (AWS & GCP) including Marketplace motion.
A strong, credible existing network among ASEAN's major SIs and cloud-native/channel partners, with a track record of moving relationships from transactional to strategic.
Comfort carrying a partner-sourced revenue quota and being measured on pipeline origination, not just deal closure.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.

Prior experience at or with a hyperscaler (AWS, GCP) in a partner or alliance capacity.
Familiarity with GitLab, DevSecOps, or adjacent developer-tooling ecosystems.
Experience helping design or reset a partner coverage model, comfortable building process rather than only inheriting one.
What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
Joint business plans and an active engagement cadence (e.g., QBRs) in place across priority hyperscaler, SI, and cloud-native/AI partners.
Demonstrable movement of key partner relationships from transactional to strategic engagement.
Growing partner-sourced pipeline and bookings against quota.
Credible input into finalizing the ASEAN Ecosystem coverage model, grounded in on-the-ground partner relationships.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
The Opportunity
Grafana Labs is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Growth based in the Netherlands who will be responsible for prospecting and growing existing business across the Benelux region . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with existing customers. You will manage forecasts and track customer data.

We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking about our products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products.
What You’ll Be Doing
Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers
Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)
Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

s.h: What Makes You a Great Fit
s.t:
5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
Fluent in English & Dutch (both spoken & written).

Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
Experience using Salesforce
Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

In the Netherlands, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 195,750 - EUR 239,500 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Pinterest Spark — because stepping away shouldn't mean falling behind
At Pinterest, our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love — and that starts with our own people. Life's biggest moments shouldn't come at the cost of the career you've built.
That's why we created Pinterest Spark.
What it is . Spark is a dedicated team of tenured Client Partners and Client Account Managers who step in to look after a colleague's clients and business while they're on a leave of absence. They safeguard relationships and revenue, keep the work moving, and hand back a healthy, thriving book when our teammate returns.
What it means for you . When you take a leave, you can be fully present for what matters — knowing your clients are in expert hands and there's a strong business to come back to, providing the confidence to step away, and the momentum to step back in.
Because creating a life you love means being able to step away — and Spark keeps your business thriving while you do.

* Technische neue Produkte: Du bearbeitest neue Anfragen, klärst Anforderungen und beurteilst gemeinsam mit unserem technischen Team die technische Machbarkeit und erarbeitest die kommerziellen Angebote bis zur Auftragsvergabe.

Bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen koordinierst du die notwendigen Abklärungen, fasst konsequent nach und begleitest Lösungen bis zum Abschluss.
* Schnittstellenkoordination: Du arbeitest eng mit Technik, Produktion, Einkauf und unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss sicher.
* Kundenbetreuung: Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen weiter aus und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
* Strategische Verkaufsplanung: Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien zur Steigerung des Umsatzes und Marktanteils.
* Budget\- und Zielverantwortung: Erstellung und Kontrolle von Verkaufsbudgets, Sicherstellung der Erreichung von Umsatz\- und Profitzielen.
### Dein Profil
* Technische Grundausbildung von Vorteil, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Verkauf
* Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Fachstellen zu entwickeln
* Interesse am Verkauf und daran, dich im technischen Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln
* Freude an Kundenkontakt, Projektarbeit und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
* Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
* Führungserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich, wichtiger sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
### Das bieten wir dir
Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Verkaufsstelle, bei der du vom ersten Tag an nur Umsatzzahlen hinterherläufst. Stattdessen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Kunden von Grund auf kennenzulernen und dich Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwor\-tungsvolle Funktion im technischen Verkauf zu entwickeln.
Wir bieten dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine technischen Kenntnisse mit Verkauf, Projektmanagement und später auch Führungsverantwortung zu verbinden.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

At Uber, we don't just move people; we move the world. As a Senior Account Manager within our Enterprise team in Poland, you are the face of Uber Eats to our most significant marketplace partners. This isn't about maintaining a static portfolio or following a generic playbook-it's about navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script.
You will own the growth and success of a massive enterprise portfolio, shifting the conversation from everyday operations to true marketplace monetization.

This role is for a resilient, resourceful sales hunter who can confidently pitch retail media, map out high-stakes promotional campaigns, and translate raw data into a clear story of business growth.

If you're energized by the messy reality of doing big things and have the grit to close deals through genuine relationship-building, this is where you'll grow.

Drive Marketplace Monetization: Actively pitch, sell, and expand the footprint of advertising products (Ads) and promotional strategies (Offers) across your enterprise portfolio to accelerate partner growth.
Speak the Language of Benefits: Use data and advanced Excel modeling to build a clear financial story, showing partners exactly how much revenue they will unlock by investing in Uber's platform tools.
Build High-Impact Partnerships: Navigate complex client relationships to earn trust fast with C-level executives, moving beyond transactional accounts to become an indispensable strategic advisor.
Master the Sales Lifecycle: Manage your pipeline with urgency and discipline, adapting your approach based on fast-moving market dynamics, client needs, and imperfect information.
Resolve Objections with Grit: Confidently lead tough commercial negotiations, stay resilient through the inevitable \"no,\" and overcome client pushback by creating mutual, scalable value.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with operations, marketing, product, and legal teams to shape complex proposals, resolve partner blockers, and deliver marketplace solutions that scale.

3+ years of commercial experience in e-commerce, retail media, food-delivery marketplaces, or high-growth B2B sales environments.
Proven track record in active selling and account growth, specifically driving revenue through digital advertising, marketing solutions, or promotional campaigns.
Fluency in Polish and English (written and spoken).
Proficiency in commercial data analysis, including advanced Excel skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn metrics into persuasive sales narratives.

Our ideal candidate brings both business acumen and technical depth , capable of guiding customers with specialized expertise to help them achieve their objectives and unlock the full value of ClickHouse.
What You’ll Be Doing
Identify and nurture opportunities, build pipeline, and close short term Cloud monthly contracts, while simultaneously developing a strategic Enterprise business with complex sales cycles.
Evangelize ClickHouse’s vision and solutions to secure strategic commercial commitments .
Take a solution-based approach to selling, delivering clear business value for customers.
Champion the innovation behind ClickHouse Cloud , driving awareness and adoption.
Manage customer details, including use cases, timelines, and forecasting, within Salesforce.
Deliver accurate monthly business forecasts .
Contribute to the ClickHouse ecosystem by engaging in local developer meetups and helping organize ClickHouse specific community events .

Proven ability to manage cross functional resources — from dedicated teams to executive staff, to drive successful outcomes.
Expertise aligning cloud solutions with customer business needs, challenges, and technical requirements.
3+ of experience in open source software business models preferred; strong background in cloud and infrastructure software required.
Passion for building long-lasting customer relationships and working cross-functionally in a diverse, global team.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills , with strong business and technical acumen.

Entrepreneurial mindset with a proven record of delivering results in fast moving environments.
Experience working effectively in a remote-first, global organization .
Prior success selling databases or deploying applications with major cloud providers.

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.
Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.
Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable , Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.
We recently raised a $355M Series C at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.
Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luig i ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders

We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.
This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.
This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.
The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.

A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.
A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed.
A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores.
An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.
A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.
An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it.
A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".
What You'll Achieve
Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and drive expansion opportunities
What You'll Need to Bring
Customer-facing experience. You've owned a revenue target or supported a revenue target in a highly technical, consumption business.
Technical depth. You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
AI builder. You're hands on building with AI tools — not just consuming workflows that were built for you.
Ownership. You run your book of business and projects like you're the CEO of it. You're highly organized bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work. You take action vs. waiting for direction.
Learning velocity. You operate with the mindset of what I can do today vs. let me pick this up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on it.
Cross-functional partner. Low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you'd rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or similar type role
Certification as an engineer (ex. Computer Science Degree, Professional Bootcamps)
Early GTM hire experience at a fast-growing startup
You've sat close to GPU spend, model training, or inference workloads

About Pleo
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high.

With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale.

If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!
Who you’ll be working with and reporting to
You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.
What you’ll be doing

s.h: As an Account Manager, you will
s.t:
Own a dedicated book of business from a purely commercial perspective, focusing heavily on a land-and-expand revenue model through cross-selling, upselling, and driving overall account growth
Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book of business, securing new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned with evolving customer needs.
Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success teams, who focus on customer adoption and retention, allowing you to stay fully focused on driving revenue and commercial outcomes.
Build deep relationships with key decision-makers (senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders) to understand their strategic initiatives and uncover whitespace opportunities.
Use MEDDICC (or similar framework) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring forecast accuracy and high deal velocity.
Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows. Leverage customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and quantify value.
Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you have
s.t:
A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach
Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value
Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)
A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach
Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability
Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders
A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention
Complete fluency in English
Why is this role a good fit for you

s.h: This role is a good fit for you if
s.t:
You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.
You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.
You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

s.h: This role is not a good fit for you if
s.t:
You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.
You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.
You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.
How you’ll develop in this role

s.h: In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll
s.t:
Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.
Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.
Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale
The location
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

s.h: We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
s.t:
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

We are looking for an experienced enterprise sales professional who understands both the strategic value of AI and the critical role that trusted data plays in delivering successful business outcomes. This role combines consultative enterprise selling, AI thought leadership, and deep engagement with senior decision-makers across large organizations.
The successful candidate will help enterprise clients unlock value through Dun & Bradstreet's Sales & Marketing Solutions, Master Data, and AI-enabled data offerings, creating measurable business impact while accelerating D&B's growth in Finland.

As a Senior Solution Sales Manager, AI & Trusted Data Solutions, you will work with some of Finland's largest enterprises, helping them improve customer acquisition, sales effectiveness, data governance, AI readiness, and business decision-making.
You will act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, translating complex AI and data concepts into tangible business value. Working closely with Relationship Managers, Client Success, Product teams, and strategic partners, you will identify opportunities, develop compelling value propositions, and execute growth strategies across existing and new accounts.
This role requires a strong understanding of enterprise AI initiatives, master data challenges, revenue generation processes, and how trusted third-party data can improve AI outcomes and business performance.

Enterprise Growth & Solution Selling
Drive new business, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within large enterprise accounts.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key stakeholders.
Develop account strategies and business plans to achieve and exceed revenue objectives.
Manage complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers and stakeholders.
Lead negotiations, business case development, and commercial discussions.
AI & Trusted Data Advisory
Help clients understand the importance of high-quality, governed data in AI initiatives.
Position Dun & Bradstreet as a strategic AI and data partner.
Demonstrate how trusted business data improves AI model effectiveness, automation, customer intelligence, risk assessment, and decision-making.
Engage with business, data, analytics, AI, and technology leaders to identify opportunities where D&B data can drive measurable value.
Act as a subject matter expert in AI data readiness, business data quality, and commercial data applications.
Master Data & Sales & Marketing Solutions
Drive adoption of D&B Master Data solutions to improve data quality, governance, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Position D&B Sales & Marketing Solutions to help clients identify, prioritize, and engage their best prospects.
Support clients in improving customer acquisition, segmentation, territory planning, and go-to-market execution.
Collaborate with technical and product specialists to design client-specific solutions.
Market Leadership
Maintain expertise in AI, data management, business intelligence, customer data, and emerging technology trends.
Represent Dun & Bradstreet at industry events, customer workshops, and executive forums.
Share market insights with internal stakeholders and contribute to product and solution development.
Build relationships with ecosystem partners including cloud providers, AI platforms, and enterprise technology vendors.

Experience
8+ years of successful enterprise sales experience.
Proven track record of exceeding sales targets within enterprise SaaS, data, analytics, technology, consulting, or software environments.
Demonstrated success selling solutions to large enterprise organizations.
Experience engaging C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
Experience managing complex multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.
AI & Data Knowledge
Strong understanding of enterprise AI initiatives and how organizations leverage AI to create business value.
Knowledge of data quality, master data management, customer data, analytics, and business intelligence concepts.
Ability to articulate the relationship between trusted data and successful AI outcomes.
Experience discussing AI strategy, governance, data readiness, and business transformation initiatives with enterprise clients.
Skills
Exceptional consultative selling and relationship management skills.
Strong business acumen and commercial mindset.
Excellent presentation, communication, and executive engagement capabilities.
Strategic thinking combined with strong execution skills.
Ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce and modern sales methodologies.
Fluency in Finnish and English is required for this role

Experience selling data, analytics, AI, cloud, master data, customer data, risk, compliance, or digital transformation solutions.
Familiarity with Microsoft, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, hyperscaler ecosystems, or enterprise data platforms.
Understanding of AI governance, data governance, and enterprise data strategies.
Experience working with B2B sales and marketing technologies.

Resumo da Posição
Buscamos um profissional em início de desenvolvimento na gestão de contas B2B, responsável por apoiar a gestão de uma carteira SMB com foco em relacionamento, retenção e crescimento. A posição atuará no acompanhamento da performance dos clientes, identificação de oportunidades de expansão e desenvolvimento das contas da carteira
Principais Responsabilidades
Gerenciar e acompanhar uma carteira de clientes SMB, com foco em retenção, relacionamento e crescimento de receita.
Identificar oportunidades de aumento de volume, upsell e cross-sell de produtos e soluções.
Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes para entender necessidades, operação e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.
Mapear a operação logística dos clientes e apoiar na construção de planos de ação para evolução das contas.
Monitorar volume, receita e principais indicadores de performance da carteira, identificando variações e oportunidades.
Apoiar análises de dados e geração de insights para retenção e crescimento dos clientes.
Acompanhar contas com queda de volume ou sinais de risco, apoiando a construção de planos de recuperação.
Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas internas como Operações, CX, Pricing, Product e Finance para resolução de demandas e desenvolvimento das contas.
Manter informações, interações e oportunidades atualizadas no CRM.
Desenvolver relacionamento de longo prazo com os clientes, aumentando gradualmente sua autonomia e conhecimento sobre a carteira.
Requisitos
Experiência de 1 a 2 anos em Customer Success, Pós-Vendas, Account Management, atendimento a clientes B2B ou áreas relacionadas.
Boa comunicação e facilidade para desenvolver relacionamento com clientes.
Capacidade analítica básica e interesse em trabalhar com dados e indicadores.
Organização e capacidade de acompanhar múltiplas contas e demandas simultaneamente.
Perfil comercial e interesse em desenvolver habilidades de negociação e gestão de contas.
Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de CRM.
Diferenciais
Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou marketplaces.
Conhecimento ou interesse em operações logísticas.
Vivência com gestão de carteira de clientes.
Conhecimento de Excel ou ferramentas de análise de dados.
Inglês avançado/fluente.
Habilidades desejáveis
Perfil proativo, organizado, colaborativo e orientado ao cliente, com interesse em desenvolver visão comercial e analítica para identificar oportunidades de retenção e crescimento dentro da carteira.

Business Development
Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients to expand the company’s customer base
Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing
Develop and execute strategies to penetrate new accounts and market segments
Collaborate with internal teams to develop compelling proposals and solutions
Revenue & Performance Management
Own revenue targets for both new business and existing accounts
Track, analyse, and forecast sales performance and account metrics
Use data insights to refine strategies and improve conversion and retention rates

Proactively identify client needs and recommend tailored solutions to support their evolving business objectives

Continuously identify areas to improve client experience and internal workflows

Experience managing full sales cycles and handling client negotiations

Highly organised with a structured, process-driven approach to managing pipelines and accounts
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at multiple levels
Self-driven, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.

We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify.
You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

Client Strategy: Lead consultative selling to inspire clients and demonstrate how Spotify can achieve their business goals.
Business Development: Proactively identify and cultivate high-potential customer relationships across diverse verticals to grow a robust sales pipeline.
Agency Partnerships: Build deep, trusted partnerships with indie agency leaders, becoming their go-to expert on audio and digital advertising through Spotify.
Sales Propositions: Craft and present effective sales propositions, leveraging the latest platform innovations, research, and key insights.
Sales Targets: Own and exceed ambitious revenue goals through strategic, entrepreneurial approaches that drive sustainable growth.
Strategic Insight & Reporting: Deliver actionable insights and detailed performance reports, analyzing campaigns to recommend improvements.
Product Expertise: Stay ahead of Spotify’s product innovations, identifying cross-selling opportunities to help clients succeed.
Pipeline Development: Skillfully manage multiple complex conversations, prioritizing engagements with efficiency using relevant software tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data teams to create comprehensive strategies and optimize platform effectiveness.

Knowledgeable: You bring a minimum of 5+ years of experience managing pipelines and driving revenue in a digital advertising tech environment. Experience in audio advertising is a plus.
Market and Segment Expertise: You have a strong understanding of the UK advertising, media, and ad tech landscape - particularly the independent agency ecosystem. You know what makes indies tick and how they differ from network agencies.
Relationship Builder: You have a proven track record of developing and maintaining strong partnerships with agencies, understanding their unique needs, structures, and decision-making processes.
Organized & Self-Reliant: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can manage multiple priorities with confidence
Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly expressing both your stakeholders’ needs and your own.
Intrinsically Motivated: You are driven by your own goals and always aim to beat your personal best.
Results Oriented: You thrive on exceeding targets and making a tangible impact.
Team-Oriented: You believe in collaborative success, eager to learn from your peers and share your expertise.
English language fluency, spoken and written is required.
Please apply with a CV in English.
Where You’ll Be
This role is based in London.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com .

Partner Sales Manager

We are looking for a Partner Sales Manager to drive revenue in collaboration with our top solution and technology partners. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity SaaS solution to large banking organizations across Switzerland.

Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the banking sector across Switzerland. Navigate complex enterprise organizations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close

Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder ecosystems including executives, administrators, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus across Swiss business culture and practices
Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from enterprise users and conveying market needs from the Swiss enterprise landscape. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for enterprise customers
Continuously refine the enterprise sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The UAE is one of our fastest-growing and most exciting markets. As Deliveroo continues to expand, we become a major revenue channel for partners across restaurant, grocery, and retail - aside from providing the best support, we are consultants that use data-driven insight and industry knowledge to help our partners grow in their industry.

Our Account Management team oversees partner relationships - they are a passionate, dynamic group of team players that work well together and cross-functionally with other departments, and of course, they're fun.
We are looking for a Retail Account Manager to join our UAE New Verticals Team. This is a great opportunity to become a critical member in one of the fastest-growing divisions at Deliveroo and drive impact across our most exciting vertical. 'Deliveroo Shopping' (Retail) covers a wide range of categories from gifts, electronics, beauty, and stationery to pet accessories.

In this role, you will manage relationships with a number of our top National and SMB Retail/Non-food partners across a small variety of categories. You will be responsible for onboarding, maintaining, and growing the partnerships as well as being the day-to-day contact between partners and Deliveroo, communicating their needs to internal teams.

You will be helping new partners to launch and succeed on the platform and grow existing business on the Deliveroo platform, developing the ‘best in class’ value proposition for our customers within a new and exciting area of our business.
What You’ll Be Doing

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Manage the relationship of our top Retail/Non-food partners, becoming the expert in this space as we scale
Driving partner performance by owning your portfolio’s business growth through proactive reporting, weekly/monthly/quarterly meetings and reviews, analysis, improvement projects, and identifying growth opportunities. You will work with both internal and external stakeholders to drive change and devise solutions to ensure issues are addressed and your accounts continue to grow.
Managing marketing and promotional planning for our Retail/Non-Food partners as they scale on the platform.
Ensuring that we are developing an ongoing attractive value proposition for customers, including selection, promotions, pricing, and service levels.
Working closely with compliance, legal, and operations to ensure best practices
Owning the execution of site roll-outs as we scale the proposition, mapping our gaps in coverage for partner expansion
Representing Deliveroo across your partner’s organisation, and ensuring that our internal stakeholders are supporting where appropriate.
What You'll Need To Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
3-4 years of experience in an account management, business development/new business, or commercial role.
Experience in working within the Retail and/or Pharmacy industry is required
Experienced negotiator with the ability to drive mutual value for both partners and Deliveroo
Partner obsessed, with effective relationship building, organisation, and communication skills, whether face to face, through video, phone, or email.
Confident working with and analysing data - able to cut through the noise to understand what performance improvements will help grow your Retail partners, in order to make clear and actionable recommendations.
Able to create ideas and strategies to drive the growth of our joint business with our partners, with a willingness to trial at pace.
Collaborative team player who is able to get the best out of the people around you. Able to work effectively with all levels of Deliveroo.
Experience working in a dynamic, high-growth company is preferable

Deliveroo is an award-winning online food delivery company on a mission to bring the world's best-loved local restaurants directly to people's doors. We are a rapidly growing company with a huge ambition, and we're always looking for top talent to join us.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Business Development Associate to join our expanding team in Belgium.

In this role, you will be instrumental in driving Deliveroo's growth by proactively identifying, engaging, and onboarding new restaurant and food business partners (including supermarkets, butchers, bakeries, etc.) onto the Deliveroo platform.

Your primary focus will be on building strong relationships with potential partners and showcasing the value proposition of partnering with Deliveroo in Brussels & Wallonia

· Actively identify and prospect potential restaurant and food business partners within your assigned territory.

· Conduct outreach (via phone, email, and in-person meetings) to introduce Deliveroo and its benefits to prospective partners.

· Present Deliveroo's value proposition clearly and persuasively, addressing the specific needs and concerns of each business.

· Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to successful onboarding of new partners.

· Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified leads.

· Negotiate partnership terms and agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

· Collaborate closely with internal teams (e.g., Onboarding, Account Management) to ensure a smooth and successful launch for new partners.

· Stay up-to-date on market trends, competitor activities, and the local food and beverage landscape.

· Meet and exceed targets for new partner acquisition.

· Maintain accurate records of sales activities and progress within CRM systems.

· Native French speaker is essential.

· Fluency in English is required.

· Proficiency in Dutch is a strong plus.

· Proven sales experience is a significant advantage.

· A genuine passion for food and the restaurant/grocery industry.

· Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

· Self-motivated, proactive, and target-driven with a strong work ethic.

· Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

· Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

· Valid driver's license and willingness to travel locally as needed.

· The opportunity to work for a fast-growing and exciting global company.

· A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

· Competitive salary and benefits package (including company car).

· Opportunities for professional development and growth.

· The chance to make a real impact on Deliveroo's success in Belgium.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Bristol & South West Areas team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Bristol and the South West/Wales region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the South West and Wales.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.
Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.
Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.
Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.
Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.
Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.
Mobility: A valid driving licence and access to a car are required, as you will be frequently travelling across Bristol and the surrounding areas.

You’ll be joining the Deliveroo for Work (DfW) team. DfW is Deliveroo’s B2B arm, offering simple and flexible food-spending solutions to corporate clients across global markets, from team lunches to office events and pantry supplies.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Own Enterprise Deals: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for high-value, multi-market partnerships with Fortune 500 and large global organisations.
Manage Strategic Accounts: Oversee account management for top global clients, driving contract renewals, retention, and account expansion with senior stakeholders.
Lead and Develop a Team: Manage, coach, and support a small team, setting clear direction to deliver against global enterprise targets.
Design Bespoke Propositions: Craft tailored commercial models, pricing, and rollout strategies that align Deliveroo's capabilities with complex client needs.
Navigate Technical & Product Complexity: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Legal teams to solve security/compliance requirements and feed customer insights into the product roadmap.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Complex B2B Commercial Experience: Significant track record closing high-value B2B deals and nurturing strategic accounts within complex procurement, legal, and security environments.
People Leadership: Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team while balancing hands-on commercial delivery.
Technical & Product Fluency: Ability to engage credibly with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to translate technical constraints into commercial outcomes.
Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence C-suite decision-makers across functions.
Strategic & Commercial Judgment: Strong commercial sharpness to structure, negotiate, and execute high-impact global partnerships through long sales cycles.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

Vos missions dans l'équipe commerciale
La santé est l'une des choses les plus précieuses que nous ayons. Or, les soignants manquent parfois de temps et de moyens pour mener leur mission à bien.
Chez Doctolib, nous voulons améliorer leur quotidien grâce à des services efficaces et innovants. Nos technologies les aident à réduire les tâches administratives pour libérer du temps médical, mieux soigner leurs patients, gagner en visibilité et développer leur activité.
En tant que Business Developer, vous serez chargé de prendre contact sur le terrain avec les praticiens de votre zone et leur proposer les solutions Doctolib. Au quotidien, vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :
Prospection terrain : décrocher des rendez-vous avec les professionnels de santé directement sur leur lieu de travail
Vente : écouter et comprendre les besoins des praticiens pour les convaincre d'adopter les solutions Doctolib (optimiser la gestion de leur pratique, gagner en visibilité, en temps médical et en confort)
Formation aux produits : assurer la formation des professionnels de santé à nos solutions au sein de leur cabinet
Reporting : utiliser le CRM Salesforce pour planifier vos tournées et tenir à jour le suivi administratif des clients

Entretien avec un recruteur : Un échange pour découvrir votre parcours, vos motivations et évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences avec nos besoins.
Rencontre avec nos Managers : Une exploration de vos compétences à travers des mises en situation concrètes et une présentation de notre équipe et mission.
Échange avec nos Senior Managers : Un approfondissement de votre candidature incluant une simulation de prise de rendez-vous pour vous projeter dans le rôle.
Immersion dans notre équipe : Une demi-journée aux côtés d'un·e Business Developer pour vivre l'expérience Doctolib de l'intérieur et vous projeter dans votre futur rôle.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own a brand-new territory: AI-native companies across Latin America. This is not a managed-account role. This is a hunter position at the start of something real.The groundwork is laid. The timing is now.
This is the first dedicated AE position for AI-native accounts in Latin America. The segment is real, the pipeline is identified, and the market timing is exceptional. Elastic is not a challenger here. We are the Search AI company, trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 500 — and we are just starting to go deep in this segment. If you want to own a territory from the ground up, with the backing of a global platform and the energy of a new market, this is it.
Latin America is generating its first wave of genuinely AI-native companies and these companies need what Elastic does best: Search AI at scale, enterprise-grade Security, and Observability that keeps up with their growth. And right now, no one at Elastic is dedicated to them. That changes with this hire.

Build and own a regional territory focused on AI-native companies across Latin America
Sell Elastic's Search AI Platform across three pillars: Search AI, Security (SIEM/XDR), and Observability
Engage CTO, CISO, and VP Engineering at high-growth AI-native companies across the region
Activate and develop strategic partnerships as regional channel multipliers
Own Your Territory & Build Pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound strategy across entities in São Paulo, leveraging community, customer, and partner ecosystems to generate ≥ 50% of your booked opportunities.
Deep Discovery & Qualification: Uncover business pains, business impact, budgets, and decision criteria using disciplined frameworks like MEDDPICC to manage high-confidence pipeline.
Value Storytelling & Demos: Deliver tailored narratives and demonstrations that map Elastic’s Search AI, Observability, and Security capabilities to core priorities and digital transformation.
Mutual Deal Strategy & Forecast Accuracy: Collaborate with stakeholders to construct formal close plans, managing sales cycles and drive predictable sales execution by maintaining 90%+ forecast accuracy within +/- 10%.
Executive Negotiation & Closing: Guide complex procurement processes, structuring give/get trades and securing multi-year consumption and project commitments.
Complex Project Execution: Drive high-value, complex projects into net-new logos while expanding Elastic usage across our current installed base.
Domain & Cloud Acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern enterprise data architectures.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and strategic Channel Partners (distributors/integrators) to accelerate deals and deliver measurable customer outcomes.
What You Will Bring
5–8 years of enterprise SaaS or cloud sales, consistently above quota
Experience leading AI, data, or cybersecurity platforms
Proven hunter: you build your own pipeline and thrive opening new accounts
Experience engaging CTO and technical leadership at high-growth tech companies
Comfortable operating across multiple countries and time zones
Portuguese and/or Spanish (native) + English (professional)
Proven SaaS Success: 5+ years of experience closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving quotas within SaaS, cloud, or consumption-based environments.
Installed Base & Net-New Growth: Demonstrated track record of selling complex projects into net-new logos as well as expanding within existing accounts.
Territory Acumen in São Paulo: Deep familiarity navigating procurement processes, budget cycles, RFIs/RFPs, and decision-making dynamics within entities in São Paulo.
Ecosystem & Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, including Enterprise Search, Logging, Security (SIEM/XDR), Observability (APM/metrics), Vector/AI Search, and Cloud platforms.
Expert Qualification & MEDDPICC Skills: Mastery in applying MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to navigate multi-stakeholder deal cycles.
Executive & Developer Credibility: Ability to build strong relationships across technical teams, developers, and executive decision-makers.
Open Source Model Appreciation: Genuine appreciation for the Open Source go-to-market model and the developer/user community that relies on Elastic solutions daily.
Languages: Native/Fluent in Portuguese; Full Professional Proficiency in English and Spanish.
Must be located in São Paulo, Brazil
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

What Is The Role Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts.

You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model.

This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.
What You Will Be Doing
Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.
Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.
Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.
Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.
Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.
Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.
Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.
Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.
Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.
Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.
If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!
