At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Senior Business Development Manager, Control Tower to drive pipeline, award conversion, and revenue growth for Flexport’s Control Tower business across our Central region. This role will sit in Chicago, with the flexibility to travel to customers across the territory when it matters (up to 25% travel).
Flexport’s Control Tower gives customers one system to manage order management, booking management, buyer’s consolidation, and supply chain optimization. You’ll be the Control Tower subject matter expert (SME) embedded in the sales process – partnering with Account Executives and sales leadership to run customer conversations, shape the right solution, demo the technology, and price deals to win without giving away margin.
This is a consultative, value-based sell with a longer cycle than a typical transactional deal. You’ll need to get genuinely fluent in a prospect’s current supply chain, systems, and headcount so you can build a credible business case for why Control Tower is worth the switch – and defend that case on price.

Owning Central region growth – driving customer count, Control Tower volume, and profitability across your sales regions.
Partnering with Account Executives – joining customer calls, coaching deal strategy, and serving as the Control Tower expert throughout the sales cycle.
Solutioning around the customer’s supply chain – understanding their current workflows, systems, and staffing well enough to design the right order management, booking management, buyer’s consolidation, or supply chain optimization fit.
Building the ROI case – using the customer’s current software costs, headcount, and process data to quantify savings and prove out the value of switching to Flexport.
Pricing to win, and to protect margin – leading commercial strategy on Control Tower deals so the business we close is profitable for Flexport, not just fast to sign.
Demoing the technology – showing AEs and prospects how Control Tower works and why it’s differentiated from point solutions and manual processes.
Translating contracts to operational SOPs - assist with SOP generation and implementation for solutions you create and deals you close.
Converting awards into attainment – staying engaged after the deal closes so awarded volume actually ships, protecting attainment against the original award.

6+ years of quota-carrying sales or business development related experience, ideally in supply chain, logistics, or supply chain software.
Consultative selling experience – comfortable running a longer, value-based sales cycle rather than a transactional one.
Working knowledge of supply chain operations – order management, booking and vendor management, buyer’s consolidation, and how shippers manage inbound freight today.
ROI and business case fluency – able to turn a customer’s current-state costs and workflows into a quantified savings story.
Strong presence with both AEs and customers – you’ll coach sales teams internally and pitch technology directly to prospects and executives.
Location and travel – based in Chicago, IL preferred, with the flexibility to travel up to 25% to customers across the Midwest and South.
Bachelor’s degree; MBA or equivalent operating experience welcome.

Control Tower is one of Flexport’s fastest-growing product lines, and this role owns a region full of the manufacturers, retailers, and distributors that need a better way to manage bookings, consolidate orders, and run their supply chain. You’ll set the playbook for how Flexport wins Control Tower business across the Central regions – working side by side with AEs to turn pipeline into awards, and awards into customers who stick around and grow.

5+ years in B2B sales including 2+ years leading high-velocity new business teams (e.g., SDR/AE or field acquisition) with a strong record of exceeding targets.

You’re energized by AI: You make time to work with AI, and you bring your team along. You build intuition through hands-on trials, help your team do the same, and turn what you all learn into real improvements to how the team works.

Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
The Opportunity
Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition based in Israel who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across Israel . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data.

We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team.

Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.
What You’ll Be Doing
Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

s.h: What Makes You a Great Fit
s.t:
2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
Experience selling into the Israel market
Fluent in English & Hebrew.

Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
Experience using Salesforce
Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu
Instacart’s retail media platform, Carrot Ads, is scaling fast — and the strategic retail partners who power it need more than a point of contact. They need a trusted advisor who knows their business, knows ours, and can translate that into advertising performance that grows over time.

Without this role, we risk leaving adoption on the table, missing signals from partners who could shape our product roadmap, and letting high-potential relationships stagnate.

We’re hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of enterprise retail partners end-to-end — from onboarding through growth — and make Carrot Ads an indispensable part of how they compete.

This role sits at the center of Instacart’s retail media expansion, with a direct line of sight to partner revenue, product adoption, and the future of how we go to market.
What you’ll cook up in your first year
A portfolio of strategic enterprise retail partners is measurably healthier — adoption is up, revenue is growing, and partners are pointing to Carrot Ads as a competitive advantage.
New retail partners are onboarded smoothly and confidently — trained on campaign tooling, demand sourcing, reporting, and invoicing — so they hit the ground running and don’t stall out early.
Partners are adopting expanded placements and new product capabilities because you’ve made the incremental revenue case clearly — and Product teams have better data to work with because of the feedback loops you’ve built.
The account management practice is sharper than when you arrived — playbooks are tighter, QBR formats are more compelling, and the team has better tools for tracking partner KPIs and scaling what works.
Cross-functional partners — from Business Development to Finance to Ads Quality — know who to call when something involves the retail partner book, because you’ve become the connective tissue across teams.

5+ years in Account Management or a related field, with experience in ad tech, publishers, or retail media.
Proven experience supporting enterprise solutions in the advertising space, including managing complex partner relationships end-to-end.
Strong technical acumen — able to understand and explain complex product capabilities to partners who may not be technical.
Proficient in data analysis with the ability to derive actionable insights and make strategic recommendations from partner KPI data.
Comfortable navigating billing, invoicing, and revenue reconciliation workflows in partnership with Finance.
Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to distill complex concepts for varied audiences — from technical teams to executive stakeholders.
Proven project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple partner relationships and internal workstreams simultaneously.
Experienced in cross-functional collaboration and executive-level presentations.

Specific industry experience in advertising, grocery, and/or e-commerce.
Proven track record of building growth narratives and revenue-driving strategies for enterprise retail partners.
Experience in collaborative management of enterprise accounts alongside sales teams in a partner-facing environment.

Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What's the opportunity?
Are you ready to lead the charge in AI-driven customer service? As an Enterprise Account Executive focused on selling Fin, our cutting-edge AI agent, you’ll play a pivotal role in revolutionizing how enterprises scale customer support. Fin leverages advanced artificial intelligence to deliver seamless, efficient, and intelligent support experiences, making it a game-changer for businesses worldwide.
This is your chance to join a world-class sales team, driving the upmarket growth of a transformative AI solution. At Fin, we don’t just sell products; we empower businesses to reimagine their customer support strategies. If you’re looking for ownership, creativity, and the opportunity to lead in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.
What will I be doing?
Champion AI transformation : Drive the adoption of Fin, helping enterprise clients unlock the power of AI to automate and scale their support operations.
Full-cycle sales ownership : Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting to close—with a consultative and tailored approach.
Customer advocate : Act as the voice of the customer, collaborating with Product, Marketing, and other teams to refine and enhance the AI-agent offering.
Tailored AI demonstrations : Create and deliver compelling, customized demos that showcase the unique value of Fin as an AI agent.
Revenue-focused : Provide timely, accurate forecasts and ensure clear visibility into your sales pipeline and performance.
Team growth : Contribute to the overall success of the sales team by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and leading innovative projects to up-level the group.
What skills do I need?
Proven success : 8+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with at least 3 years selling SaaS solutions to enterprise clients.
Hunter mentality: Proven track record of outbounding and creating the majority of your pipeline and revenue.
AI expertise : Familiarity with AI-powered solutions, customer engagement tools, or support automation products is a strong advantage.
Quota achiever : Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
Strategic communicator : Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex AI solutions.
Solution-focused : Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing opportunities across diverse industries.
Customer-centric mindset : Skilled at building trust and creating value in competitive sales landscapes.
Growth-oriented : Displays intellectual curiosity, ambition, and a commitment to personal and team development

Policies
Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications.

We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values .
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. The Mid-Market Sales Executive is responsible for sales and revenue growth in their assigned, targeted accounts. This individual is responsible for building a sales pipeline, managing a sales process for their mid-market brands/group with 40 to 500 units.
This role can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.

Lead efforts to grow Toast market share in the multi-unit restaurant industry through establishment and cultivation of ongoing relationships at the C-Suite level through research, cold-calling and networking to develop a qualified pipeline of prospects.
Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast value proposition of products and solutions through demonstrations and presentations communicating a compelling purchase rationale.
Cultivate relationships with business partner counterparts who sell and support complementary applications and services to point of sale systems serving the restaurant industry
Plan, direct and coordinate sales support activities, including management of the sales pipeline through Toast sales tools (Salesforce)
Involved in all phases of the sales lifecycle including: identifying and developing leads; meeting with clients; developing value propositions; financial deal structuring; contract negotiation and closing
Understand the competitive landscape (strengths, weaknesses, benefits) and determine how to position Toast to win
Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation Teams to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
Own your own leverage. Continuously identify the repetitive parts of the role-research, prep, notes, follow-up, list building and systematically get them off your plate, so the majority of your week is spent in live conversation with operators.
Work evidence, not alphabetical order. Prioritize accounts based on observable change in the operator's business: expansion, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology, and disqualify unworkable accounts quickly so your capacity concentrates where it can actually close.
Treat your book as an asset you maintain. Keep account and contact records accurate, current, and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring, and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
Untangle who really decides. Resolve complex ownership structures, franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to identify and reach the actual economic decision maker rather than whoever answers the phone.
Arrive already informed, and earn trust in a low-trust market. Focus on the operator's specific situation rather than a product pitch, and recognize that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor; credibility, not feature comparisons, is often what wins the deal.
Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad data, wrong contacts, and signals that didn't hold up, so the system your whole team relies on improves rather than quietly eroding.

A combination of SaaS, Digital Marketing and Restaurant Industry Technology experience is required
5+ years of relevant successful technology or professional services sales experience
Previous success in selling/leading sales efforts in environments with 6 to 12 month sales cycles
